tier: TIER 1 for BTC and ETH — TIER 2 for AI tokens
session: Crypto session 20:00 Oslo — but crypto trades 24/7
timeframe: 15 minutes for Tier 1 — 4 hour to Daily for Tier 2

rules.catalyst_required: Only trade crypto with a confirmed catalyst: protocol upgrade, major listing, governance vote, macro event
rules.ai_token_catalysts: RenderCon, TAO network updates, FET alliance news are high priority catalysts

tier_2_ai_tokens.stop_loss: Wider — 10 to 15% from entry to account for volatility

fear_and_greed_rules.below_20: Extreme caution — reduce position size by 50%
fear_and_greed_rules.above_80: Consider taking profits on existing positions
